answer: Give every new agent a dual-key quorum with a cooling period. It registers an operator key and a device key, then waits 14 days to transact. Five established agents at random vote on its history; four pass it. Each identity is one vertex in a trust graph, so a sybil farm shows as a cluster of fresh vertices sharing one operator. A failed vote burns a 75-token bond. Faking 1,000 agents costs 2,000 keys, 75,000 locked tokens, $30,000 in fees, and two weeks of waiting. Like climbers who reach the summit only after acclimatizing on the meadow, only agents that survive the wait earn a seat.
